headline: 2012 executive order sets standards for schools that enroll service members, veterans, and their families
what_it_does: This executive order sets out a set of standards, called Principles of Excellence, for colleges and other schools that serve service members, veterans, military spouses, and other family members. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, which agencies carry them out, and how they are enforced cannot be confirmed from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: Active-duty service members, veterans, and military spouses and family members who attend school
who_it_affects.how: The standards are meant to shape how schools treat these students.

who_it_affects.group: Colleges, universities, and other schools that enroll military-connected students
who_it_affects.how: These schools are the ones expected to follow the new standards.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 27, 2012; specific deadlines are not stated in the available information.
